concerns.text: FR-006 and SC-006 require calculating the correlation between predicted B* and an independent measure of model uncertainty (perplexity or output entropy). Task T031 implements the calculation logic, but no task exists to GENERATE the ground truth perplexity or output entropy data (which requires a separate greedy inference pass not covered in US-1 or US-2). Without a task to produce this data, FR-006 cannot be satisfied.

FR-003 and US-3 explicitly require training REGRESSION models (predicting continuous/ordinal B* with MAE/RMSE). However, Task T027 explicitly instructs the implementer to train CLASSIFICATION models (predicting discrete classes) and notes a contradiction with the Plan. While T027 flags the issue, there is no task to actually RESOLVE this contradiction (e.g., 'Update Plan to match Spec' or 'Implement Regression logic as per Spec'). The implementation will proceed with the wrong model type unless a specific task is added to fix the Plan/Spec alignment or implement the correct regression logic.

FR-002 and US-2 require extracting 'mean attention entropy calculated per the diffusion architecture definition'. Task T020 mentions 'across all layers' but does not explicitly include a task to implement the specific 'diffusion architecture definition' logic (which may differ from standard transformer attention). If the diffusion definition requires specific layer weighting or masking not present in standard libraries, this logic is missing from the tasks.

Task T027 contains a comment: 'Explicitly reconcile this in code comments or amend Plan if classification is required.' This is a task instruction to the developer to make a decision, rather than a defined task to execute a specific requirement. The spec mandates regression; the plan mandates classification. A task should be added to 'Amend Plan to align with Spec FR-003' or 'Implement Regression models as per Spec' to ensure the requirement is met, rather than leaving the resolution to a code comment.
